attributes.context: The provision appears under Section 3, New Equipment, in Article 6, following Section 2, Workweek Reduction.

extraction_text: Where new types of equipment and/or operations, for which rates of pay are not established by this Agreement, are put into use after the ratification date of this Agreement within operations covered by this Agreement, rates governing such operations shall be subject to negotiations between the parties. This paragraph shall apply to all new types of equipment including office and clerical equipment. In the event agreement cannot be reached within sixty (60) days after the date such equipment is put into use, the matter may be submitted to the National Grievance Committee for final disposition. Rates agreed upon or awarded shall be effective as of the date equipment is put to use.

attributes.context: This is in Section 4, Technological Change, which defines technological change as significant changes in equipment or materials affecting bargaining unit work or reducing workers.

extraction_text: The Employer and the Union agree to establish a National Teamster/UPS Committee for Technological Change, consisting of an equal number of representatives from the Union and UPS. The Committee shall meet upon request, but not less than three (3) times per year, to review any planned technological changes covered by this Section.

attributes.context: The section requires the National Teamster/UPS Committee for Technological Change to review planned technological changes and defines technological change.

extraction_text: The Employer will advise the affected Local Unions and the National Teamster/UPS Committee for Technological Change of any proposed technological changes when the change has entered the field testing phase or at least six (6) months prior to the implementation of such change except where the change was later determined in which case the Employer shall provide as much notice as possible. In all cases, the Company will provide notice of any technological change covered by this Section before the technology is implemented.

attributes.context: The clause is in Section 4, Technological Change, and follows the employer's notice obligation concerning proposed technological changes.

extraction_text: The Technological Change Committee shall also have the right to raise and attempt to resolve any claim that the Company’s technological change violates any provision of the National Master Agreement or the applicable Supplement, Rider or Addendum.
